description: Pilot test job for the Money Dynasty auto-video pipeline. Three scenes, one highlight subtitle per scene.

scenes.fallback_prompt: dramatic photograph of the New York Stock Exchange building on Wall Street
scenes.narration: Vanguard manages thirteen trillion dollars. More than the economy of most countries.

scenes.fallback_prompt: photograph of a stock market trading screen with rising green charts
scenes.narration: It grew by doing the opposite of Wall Street. [HL]It charges almost nothing[/HL], and lets the market do the work.

scenes.fallback_prompt: photograph of gold bars and stacks of money in a vault
scenes.narration: One man started it in 1975 with a simple idea. The investor should keep the returns, not the manager.

script: Vanguard manages thirteen trillion dollars. More than the economy of most countries. It grew by doing the opposite of Wall Street. [HL]It charges almost nothing[/HL], and lets the market do the work. One man started it in 1975 with a simple idea. The investor should keep the returns, not the manager.
title: TEST — How Vanguard Became a $13 Trillion Giant (45-second pilot)
